small.name: Small Launcher (Electron-class)
small.description: Small rocket for CubeSats and smallsats to LEO.
small.why: Cheap and quick, but can only lift small payloads to low orbit.

medium.name: Medium Launcher (Falcon 9-class)
medium.description: Workhorse medium rocket for most Earth and some lunar missions.
medium.why: Good balance of cost and capacity. Can reach LEO, GEO, and some lunar.

heavy.name: Heavy Launcher (Falcon Heavy-class)
heavy.description: Heavy-lift for large spacecraft and deep-space missions.
heavy.why: Expensive but can send big payloads to the Moon and Mars.

sls.name: Super Heavy (SLS-class)
sls.description: The largest rocket, for flagship missions like Artemis.
sls.why: Massive capacity and cost. Overkill for most missions.
